name: Ashfall
desc: Ash falling after a fire — dark tumbling flakes drift down with rare glowing cinders cooling orange-to-red, over a broad ember-lit smoke pall glowing from below; drops any scene into the aftermath of a burn or a volcanic dusk.

style.doc: ashfall=cold grey ash + warm pall / volcanic=ember-heavy red pall / incinerator=dense hot / monochrome=austere grey print, no cinders
